answer: Meetup attendance is proven by matching the RSVP list against the door scans, and the vault of the design is that the RSVP must exist before the meetup and the scan must follow it. The willow of the scheme is that a walk-in without an RSVP is recorded separately, so the two populations are never mixed. A Sybil cannot inflate meetup attendance by RSVPing a hundred fake names, because the zenith of the match requires a scan for every RSVP that counts.
